entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He's strong...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you're really a god, you should be[n]guiding humans to your ideals!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're destroying them because you[n]can't do that, aren't you? So that you[n]can flaunt your own existence.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's why you were observing us![n]You had to because the reaction of[n]the "masses" worried you!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That sounds about right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't know how long you lived, but[n]you're the perfect example of a pain-in-[n]the-ass old man!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You find people like that everywhere.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: What drivel...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What is this!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, I can't see anything!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you want to erase us from this world[n]that much!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: G-Guys!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Since you've been forsaken by the world,[n]there is nowhere that you can belong.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We... can't lose... like this...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we lose... the world is...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I need to... get back up...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ngh... My strength...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I can't... go on...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Is this it?

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Not even one sliver of unpredictability[n]can be permitted under my control.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Do you hear the voices of the masses?

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: They mock you for revolting against a god.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Humans are naught but clumps of desire.[n]Logic dictates that a world filled with them[n]will decline.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: The sin of rebelling against a god is severe.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: As punishment, you shall taste pain[n]everlasting.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Not letting that happen!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: The attendant created from the dregs of[n]human hope, hm?

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: It is impossible for a petty existence like[n]you to overrule my precedent.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Human hope is a desire too! You better[n]not underestimate it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves will yield to no one,[n]no matter who they are!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even if only one of us remains, we'll get[n]back up and fight to the very end.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And we'll definitely... definitely...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Take the world!
